info.title: StayFn.Cli
info.description: stayfn command-line tool: new, catalog, sdk, validate, run, replay, ohip ping, dev.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Scaffold from the shared MCP templates: the class, its WireMock tests and a catalog doc stub; or a whole tenant project (exit 0 written, 1 refused, 2 usage)

options.name: --description
options.description: Catalog description

options.name: --input
options.description: Input member name:type (? = optional, [] = list); repeat

options.name: --output
options.description: Output member name:type; repeat

options.name: --operation

options.name: --event
options.description: Event name of a handler, e.g. reservation.changed

options.name: --schedule
options.description: 6-field cron of a scheduled function, e.g. "0 0 2 * * *"

options.description: Class directory relative to --root

commands.name: project
commands.description: A ready tenant repository: functions and tests projects on the SDK packages, a sample function with its test, docker-compose PostgreSQL, .env.example, .mcp.json, nuget.config, VS Code settings (exit 0 written, 1 refused, 2 usage)

options.name: --dir
options.description: Target directory (default ./<name>); must not exist or be empty

options.name: --feed
options.description: Package source of the StayFn packages written into nuget.config: a URL or a local folder (default nuget.org, where they are public; no credentials)

options.name: --sdk-version
options.description: StayFn SDK package version (default: this tool's version)

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Project name: dot-separated C# identifiers, e.g. MyHotelFunctions

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Function catalog commands

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export the function catalog as sorted, timestamp-free JSON or markdown

options.name: --format
options.description: json (default) or markdown [default: json]

options.name: --operations
options.description: Include the OHIP operation rows (≈2,850) [default: False]

options.name: --assemblies
options.description: Additional function assemblies (the reference set is always included)

options.name: --out
options.description: Write to this file instead of stdout

commands.name: sdk
commands.description: Caller SDK commands (ADR-0004 A2)

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate a typed caller SDK (exit 0 written, 1 host refused or unreachable, 2 usage)

options.name: --lang
options.description: csharp (types + StayFnClient over the StayFn.Client package) or typescript (Node 18+ ES module, no dependencies)

options.name: --area
options.description: Only these areas; repeat

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory (default ./StayFn.Sdk or ./stayfn-client)

options.name: --from
options.description: Base URL of a running host; the catalog is read with a functions:read key (default: offline from the assemblies)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Tenant API key for --from (default STAYFN_API_KEY); never printed

options.name: --assemblies
options.description: Additional function assemblies for the offline catalog (the reference set is always included)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: C# namespace (default StayFn.Sdk)

options.name: --client-name
options.description: C# client class (default StayFnClient)

options.name: --package-name
options.description: npm package name (default stayfn-client)

commands.name: replay
commands.description: Replay a dead letter through the admin API (exit 0 enqueued, 1 refused, 2 configuration)

options.name: --dead-letter
options.description: Id of the dead letter to replay

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant id (for a system-scope owner token)

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Host base URL (default STAYFN_BASE_URL, else http://localhost:5080)

options.name: --token
options.description: Admin JWT, operator or owner (default STAYFN_ADMIN_TOKEN)

commands.name: ohip
commands.description: OHIP connectivity commands

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Obtain a token and fetch hotel details (entcfg getHotel) through the StayFn pipeline

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment name; variables OHIP_<ENV>_* are read (see .env.example)

options.name: --hotel
options.description: Hotel code sent as x-hotelid

commands.name: stream-probe
commands.description: Connect to the Streaming API, subscribe newEvent and print structure only (exit 0 acknowledged, 1 configuration, 2 credentials refused, 3 upstream)

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment name; OHIP_<ENV>_* plus CHAIN_CODE, HOTEL_ID and optional WEBSOCKET_URL

options.name: --seconds
options.description: Seconds each session stays subscribed (default 60) [default: 60]

options.name: --offset-type
options.description: highest: start from the latest event (NewEventInput.offsetType)

options.name: --offset
options.description: Offset to start from (wins over --offset-type)

options.name: --hotel-code
options.description: hotelCode filter; repeat

options.name: --delta
options.description: Subscribe with delta: true [default: False]

options.name: --max-events
options.description: End a session after this many events

options.name: --subprotocol
options.description: graphql-transport-ws (default), graphql-ws (legacy message types) or none [default: graphql-transport-ws]

options.name: --ping-seconds
options.description: Client ping interval; 0 sends none (default 10) [default: 10]

options.name: --corrupt-token
options.description: Send a deliberately corrupted token (learn the close code) [default: False]

options.name: --upgrade-headers
options.description: Also send Authorization/x-app-key on the upgrade request [default: False]

options.name: --no-key-hash
options.description: Omit the ?key=<sha256 of the app key> query (reproduces the gateway's bare 400) [default: False]

options.name: --sessions
options.description: Consecutive connections (never concurrent; default 1) [default: 1]

options.name: --resume
options.description: Later sessions resume at next (last + 1, default) or same (first offset again: redelivery check) [default: next]

options.name: --gap-seconds
options.description: Wait between sessions (at least 10, default 12) [default: 12]

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Run the local dev host: PostgreSQL (docker compose when needed), the host in the Development profile with the dev tenant and /api/dev/*, rebuilds on change, a dev token in .stayfn/dev-token (plan T7b.2)

options.name: --root
options.description: Directory to run in (default: the repository root above the working directory, else the working directory); .stayfn/ is written here

options.name: --url
options.description: URL the host listens on [default: http://localhost:5080]

options.name: --project
options.description: Functions project (.csproj) to build and watch (default: the repository's reference functions, or the single project of the working directory)

options.name: --host
options.description: Path of StayFn.Host.dll (default: next to the CLI — the installed tool carries it — else the repository build)

options.name: --env
options.description: OHIP environment name the dev tenant uses (variables OHIP_<ENV>_*) [default: sandbox]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration of the projects and the host [default: Debug]

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Do not build or watch the functions project (restart only through POST /api/dev/reload) [default: False]

options.name: --no-compose
options.description: Never start PostgreSQL with docker compose [default: False]

commands.name: seed
commands.description: Create or update the development tenant, environment and hotel in the database (idempotent) and print the tenant id

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment name; variables OHIP_<ENV>_* describe the gateway, credentials (as env: secret references) and hotel

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Display name of the development tenant

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: Tenant id (default: the Runtime:DevTenant default id)

commands.name: token
commands.description: Mint a development admin JWT from STAYFN__Auth__SigningKey (Development only) and print it

options.name: --role
options.description: Admin role claim: owner, operator or viewer

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant the token is bound to (required for operator/viewer; omitted for a cross-tenant owner)

options.name: --subject
options.description: Subject (sub) claim; default dev-<role>

options.name: --lifetime
options.description: Token lifetime as hh:mm:ss (default Auth:DevTokenLifetime, 8 h)

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Model Context Protocol server for AI authoring

commands.name: stdio
commands.description: Serve the StayFn MCP server over stdin/stdout for Claude Code (no database; logs on stderr)

options.name: --assemblies
options.description: Paths of additional function assemblies to put in the catalog (the shipped reference set is always included)

options.name: --specs
options.description: Directory of the committed OHIP specs (default: <repo>/tools/ohip-specs/26.3.0.0, else the snapshot shipped with the tool)

options.name: --root
options.description: The only directory function.scaffold writes under and function.validate reads from (default: the repository root)

commands.name: sandbox
commands.description: The StayFn Sandbox: a hosted synthetic OPERA Cloud for building functions (ADR-0006)

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Check a StayFn Sandbox token and write the sandbox settings into the project's .env (exit 0 connected, 1 input, 2 token refused, 3 sandbox unavailable)

options.name: --root
options.description: Project folder whose .env is written (default: the current folder) [default: <path>]

options.name: --env
options.description: StayFn environment name; settings OHIP_<ENV>_* (default sandbox) [default: sandbox]

options.name: --url
options.description: StayFn Sandbox base URL [default: https://sandbox.stayfn.com]

options.name: --token-stdin
options.description: Read the token from the first line of stdin instead of a hidden prompt [default: False]

commands.name: equivalence
commands.description: OPERA 5 vs OHIP equivalence harness (plan T7.5)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run the equivalence harness and report diffs on the covered fields

options.name: --root
options.description: Repository root fixture paths are relative to (default: found from the current directory)

options.name: --fixtures
options.description: Fixtures directory (default: <root>/tests/fixtures/equivalence)

options.name: --case
options.description: Run one case by name

options.name: --compare
options.description: values (default) or presence [default: values]

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the JSON report here

options.name: --ohip-env
options.description: Run the OHIP side against OHIP_<ENV>_* (read-only calls; forces presence mode)

options.name: --hotel
options.description: Hotel code for --ohip-env

options.name: --confirmation
options.description: Confirmation number for --ohip-env

options.name: --list
options.description: List the cases (name, function, kind) instead of running them [default: False]
